summary: Iteration 130 - News Channel Dispatch Testing Complete. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Multi-channel news distribution feature working correctly: digital_signage channel sets signage_eligible=true, public /api/news/digital-signage/feed endpoint returns eligible posts without auth, push channel now triggers dispatch even with priority=normal (fix verified), all 4 dispatch triggers (create, update, publish, approve) working correctly.

create_post_with_digital_signage_channel.details: POST /api/news/posts with channels=[intranet,push,digital_signage] + status=published correctly sets signage_eligible=true in DB

digital_signage_feed_no_auth.details: GET /api/news/digital-signage/feed returns posts with signage_eligible=true, no auth required (public endpoint)

post_without_digital_signage_excluded.details: Posts without digital_signage in channels do NOT appear in digital-signage feed

push_channel_normal_priority.details: Creating post with push in channels + priority=normal triggers dispatch (fix for issue where push only fired for critical/important)

email_channel_newsletter.details: Creating post with email in channels triggers newsletter dispatch (regression check passed)

news_feed_regression.details: GET /api/news/feed endpoint still works correctly (regression check)

publish_endpoint_dispatch.details: POST /api/news/posts/{id}/publish triggers channel dispatch based on channels array

update_to_published_dispatch.details: PUT /api/news/posts/{id} transitioning to published triggers channel dispatch

approval_workflow_dispatch.details: Moderator approval via /api/news/posts/{id}/approve-review triggers channel dispatch

all_channels_combined.details: Post with all channels (intranet, push, email, digital_signage) created and dispatched successfully

seed_data_creation: Test posts created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 130 news channel dispatch feature fully tested.
